project_type: Electron desktop app with Lit web components
test_framework: No formal test suite found - manual verification via app launch
build_command: npx electron-forge make (heavy) or npm start for dev
test_command: No automated tests - validate via AST/syntax check: node --check src/index.js
verification_instructions: Run node --check on all modified files to verify no syntax errors. Check that the app entry point loads without crashing.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot npm install. Use AST validation (node --check) and manual code review for verification.
contribution_requirements: Commit directly on refactor/ux-session-complete branch. No new npm packages.
key_patterns: IPC handlers in src/index.js use ipcMain.handle with try/catch returning {success, data/error}. Main-to-renderer communication via sendToRenderer() (BrowserWindow.webContents.send). Renderer uses global cheatingDaddy object and _eventBus (EventTarget). Typing pipeline: TypingManager -> InjectionScheduler -> backend.inject(). Storage uses JSON files with in-memory caching in storage.js.
directory_structure: src/index.js (main process entry), src/utils/window.js (window creation + hotkeys), src/utils/renderer.js (renderer bridge + global APIs), src/utils/gemini.js (AI session management), src/typing/ (typing pipeline), src/storage.js (JSON file persistence), src/services/StorageService.js (cache wrapper)
